title: Text-generation performance gets measurable
summary:
Text-generation calls gained content-free performance tracking, alongside tighter model request handling and username propagation.

Optional tracking now records model, provider, timing, token usage and outcome without sending message content. Tracking failures are handled separately from generation.

Search-preview requests are limited to supported parameters, Azure Grok requests with a seed now send it as null, and telemetry pricing lookups require an exact model-name match.

Token validation now returns a username that is carried through authentication, with the user ID as a fallback.
